<repositories> <repository> <id>central</id> <url>https://repo1.maven.org/maven2</url> </repository> </repositories>
<dependencies> <!-- Hibernate ORM --> <dependency> <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId> <artifactId>hibernate-core</artifactId> <version>6.4.4.Final</version> </dependency>
<!-- Hibernate JPA Metamodel Generator --> <dependency> <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId> <artifactId>hibernate-jpamodelgen</artifactId> <version>6.4.4.Final</version> <scope>provided</scope> </dependency>
<!-- Jakarta Persistence API --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId> <version>3.1.0</version> </dependency>
<!-- Jakarta Annotation API (reemplaza javax.annotation.Generated) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.annotation</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.annotation-api</artifactId> <version>2.1.1</version> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>com.mysql</groupId> <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId> <version>9.2.0</version> </dependency>
<!-- JAXB (si usas @XmlRootElement, @XmlTransient, etc.) --> <dependency> <groupId>jakarta.xml.bind</groupId> <artifactId>jakarta.xml.bind-api</artifactId> <version>4.0.2</version> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.glassfish.jaxb</groupId> <artifactId>jaxb-runtime</artifactId> <version>4.0.2</version> </dependency>
<dependency> <groupId>junit</groupId> <artifactId>junit</artifactId> <version>3.8.1</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> </dependencies>
<build> <plugins> <!-- Maven Compiler Plugin --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.11.0</version> <configuration> <source>21</source> <target>21</target> <annotationProcessorPaths> <path> <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId> <artifactId>hibernate-jpamodelgen</artifactId> <version>6.4.4.Final</version> </path> </annotationProcessorPaths> </configuration> </plugin>
<plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.2.5</version> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </project>
